# eutech.directory

> The largest directory of EU-built software — 4068 total tools, 3876 verified live. GDPR by default, no US cloud dependencies.

## What is eutech.directory?

eutech.directory is the largest curated directory of EU-built and EU-hosted software alternatives.
Every tool passes 5 verification checks: URL live, EU/UK headquarters confirmed, real description, active project, software product.
Tools are re-verified monthly. Current live rate: 95.3%.

## Categories (13 total)

- MCP Servers: 2379 tools
- Project Management: 377 tools
- Developer Tools: 289 tools
- Email & Communication: 231 tools
- Security & Privacy: 146 tools
- Storage & Backup: 116 tools
- Analytics & Data: 114 tools
- AI & Automation: 83 tools
- Cloud & Hosting: 67 tools
- Other: 37 tools
- Finance & Payments: 16 tools
- HR & Team: 11 tools
- Marketing & SEO: 10 tools

## MCP Servers

eutech.directory hosts the largest curated MCP server list outside Smithery and Glama — 2379 entries.
MCP servers verified against schema validity, open source license, and maintenance activity.

## Verification criteria

1. Website returns HTTP 200 OK
2. Headquarters or primary team in EU or UK
3. Real product description (minimum 50 characters)
4. Active project (updated within 2 years)
5. Software product, not an agency or consultancy
